columns.name: carcinogenic_label
columns.description: whether this molecule is carcinogenic or not

columns.name: num_single_bonds
columns.description: number of single bonds in the molecule, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_triple_bonds
columns.description: percentage of triple bonds in the molecule

columns.name: num_atom_types
columns.description: number of different atom types in the molecule, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: ratio_of_Hydrogen_elements
columns.description: ratio of Hydrogen elements in the molecule, calculated as the number of Hydrogen atoms divided by the total number of atoms.

columns.name: has_double_bonded_Carbon_atom
columns.description: set to 1 if the molecule has a double bonded Carbon atom, otherwise, set to 0
